## Checklist

- [ ] The checks pass locally: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy`, `lint-imports`, `pytest`.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests, and a fixed bug has a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] The safety rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md` still hold: every drop is a copy, no source file is
      modified, moved or overwritten, and the import boundaries are respected.
- [ ] New user-facing text is translatable, and the layout works right-to-left.
- [ ] A new dependency has a license that allows bundling, and is listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] Docs are updated where the change affects them.
